scenario: `direction` compares the two newest samples in the window per LSER.10.9; its output is an `Int?`: -1 falling, 0 steady, +1 rising, `null` while cold and over one sample ([LSER.17.2], [LSER.19.8]). `t.direction > 0` is the rising test. Compile-time pin only: a series declaring a `direction` aggregation parses cleanly and resolves the slot. The runtime answer is pinned by `logical/LSER.10.9_direction_is_int` and `logical/LSER.10.9_direction_newest_pair`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    direction sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where t.direction > 0
->
    log info "x"
